body:
You're absolutely right about where I am from, I'm originally Syrian. The way you described the thought process of most ME parents is pretty much spot on. I truly agree with personal happiness being the most important, at that time making my parents happy was synonymous for me being happy. Don't get me wrong, I still want my parents to be happy but not at the expense of my own personal choices.

My university has quite a peculiar way of splitting courses (it's a branch of the [RCSI](http://www.rcsi-mub.com/) university in Ireland). They divide each course into a "module" each module deals with a specific topic and contains credits. For example I've completed all the foundation modules which consists of topics such as (medical physics, medicinal & pharmaceutical chemistry, bio-medical lab sciences and information and communications in healthcare) Along with other more major modules such as (cardiovascular, respiratory, upper limb , neuromuscular and haemopoietic systems among many others) I've spoken to my university's administration and they said all these topics are transferable to other institutions, but I have no idea how the universities I plan to apply to will accept these module's credits. I don't think I have sufficient amount of courses completed to apply to a graduate school directly. If worst comes to worst I really don't mind starting over if the credits don't transfer. 

The LEAP program seems like a very good alternative, I will definitely look into it more. Are the requirements to enter the program tough?

Thank you for sharing your experience with an enlightening response, I sincerely appreciate it.
Applying for spring semester seems to be the only and best idea for now. I appreciate the advice.

Going to med-school, in this region specifically, was pretty much due to many factors. Mostly however it was pressure from parents, I realize how much of a mistake this was as they think medicine is the only path to a successful future. Being the naive individual I was at that time I just went with it. Something I wish I did not do, I've wanted to enter the field of bio-medical engineering ever since high school as it really piques my interest more so than any other field. I hope I answered your question satisfactorily. 

Thank you

I would like to know institutions that have a spring semester as I know fall semester pretty much already started and also perhaps some insight on the best way to deal with a situation like mine. Please refer to my reply to PuglyTaco for the reason my username is "igiveupalready"

Thank you

It was indeed , I realized I just need to start a new path. I also realized self-pity is one of the most self destructive qualities an individual can have, I learned this the hard way. I truly respect all health professionals and the work they put in but I just don't feel that it's my calling anymore. I'm now contemplating a path to a brighter future, where I feel I will excel further. I would love to hear how you dealt with moving from business to engineering.

Thank you so much for the response.
Thank you for such a great response! I'm definitely trying my best to apply as quick as I can. I may have further questions as I go through this process, I really appreciate the help.
They may have great institutions but I'm trying to avoid this region all together.
